_comment: plan-quests.md C4, quest 1 of 4 — the talk_to verb, and the quest that demonstrates D3's retroactive credit on purpose: a player who has already spoken to the farmer or the crier cascades straight to the report stage on accepting, and that is better met on a deliberately trivial errand than on a real one. Offered and turned in by the Hermit, who stands ~3 units from both targets. Reward: 150 XP (half of the level-1 requirement) and nothing else — this is the tutorial-shaped quest. Text deliberately plain (PO 2026-08-02: no lore or stylized quest text yet — simple, direct wording only).
